title: Eleven Turns and One Shop
subtitle: 街角与方位 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 街角与方位（生活与学习·社区与方位）
meta: 主题语境：街角与方位（生活与学习·社区与方位）　|　核心词汇：corner　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 corner 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my grandmother ① turned a corner she had not turned in eleven years, and she said the turning was the whole of the errand. The ② corner, meaning the bend and not the shop, held one lamp and stayed that dark; corner, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it stays unlit.

Every ③ corner on that route had the same lamp, and the ④ corner at the end, meaning the one she kept for the shortcut and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever took twice. Corner, my mother said, is nine parts lamp and one part somebody willing to turn; my grandmother said the turning is the part that fills the errand.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the corner was the whole of the match, meaning the kick and not the bend. The ⑥ corner, meaning the kick and not any of that, is the only thing in a match that everybody waits for and nobody scores from; corner, he said, is either something you turn or the only word that means both a bend and a kick. She said the kick is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ corner had become a line in a directory, and the directory had become an argument about the lamp. The ⑧ corner of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in November, was one errand and thirty years of turning; corner, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to turn. He said the turning was never mentioned.

The ⑨ corner I remember is the one at the end, which she turned in 1969 and is still described as the darkest in the county. A ⑩ corner, my mother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being turned; every corner, she said, is a kick that has agreed to look like a bend. She said the kick was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 拐角（指那道弯本身，与那家店铺相对）
C. 固定搭配：turn a corner 转弯；转机
D. n. 拐角（指那条路线上每一个）
E. n. 拐角（指末尾那个）
F. n. 角球（足球中的 corner kick）
G. n. 拐角（指名录里提到的那个）
H. n. 转角；隅（抽象总称）

items.q: turned a corner she had not turned in eleven years
The corner, meaning the bend and not the shop
the corner was the whole of the match
the corner had become a line in a directory
The corner of the whole thing
A corner, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: turn a corner 意为“转弯”，1955 年祖母转过了一个她十一年没转过的弯。
corner 意为“拐角”，指那道弯本身而不是那家店铺，那里只有一盏灯。
corner 指那条路线上每一个拐角，每一个都挂着同样的灯。
corner 指末尾那个（她留给近道的那个），是唯一有人走过两次的。
corner 意为“角球”，父亲说角球就是那场比赛的全部，指的是角球而不是那道弯。
corner 为体育用法，指角球而不是那道弯，是比赛里人人都等、却无人直接得分的东西。
corner 意为“拐角”，指名录里提到的那个，到 1963 年这个拐角成了名录里的一行。
corner 意为“转角、隅”，祖母十一月写道，整件事的转角是一趟差事三十年的转弯。
corner 意为“角落、拐角”，我记得的是末尾那个，她 1969 年转过，至今仍被说成全县最暗的。
corner 为抽象总称，母亲说一个拐角是唯一会因为被转过而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年祖母转过了一个她十一年没转过的弯，她说转弯才是这整趟差事的全部。（turn a corner）
那个拐角，指的是那道弯本身而不是那家店铺，只有一盏灯，并且一直是那么暗。（corner）
那条路线上每一个拐角都挂着同样的灯。（corner）
末尾那个拐角，指的是她留给近道的那个，是唯一有人走过两次的。（corner）
父亲说角球就是那场比赛的全部，指的是角球而不是那道弯。（corner）
1971 年母亲说，一个拐角是唯一会因为被转过而变好的东西。（corner）
answers: In 1955 my grandmother turned a corner she had not turned in eleven years, and she said the turning was the whole of the errand.
The corner, meaning the bend and not the shop, held one lamp and stayed that dark.
Every corner on that route had the same lamp.
The corner at the end, meaning the one she kept for the shortcut and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever took twice.
My father said the corner was the whole of the match, meaning the kick and not the bend.
A corner, my mother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being turned.
